On this walk you explore the city wall, colonial Delhi and the uprising of 1857.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Kashmere Gate public viewpoint
  • Nearby historic streets
  • Selected surviving building exteriors
  • Reflection

How the time is spent

  1. Kashmere Gate public viewpoint 25 min

    Outline 1857 events carefully through sources.

    You: map conflict

  2. Nearby historic streets 35 min

    Trace transport and city walls.

    You: historic map comparison

  3. Selected surviving building exteriors 35 min

    Separate surviving fabric from later memorial narratives.

    You: photo notes

  4. Reflection 25 min

    Discuss competing memories and colonial archives.

    You: primary-source question

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Kashmere Gate & 1857 using material evidence and a site map.
  • Explore the city wall, colonial Delhi and the uprising of 1857.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
Kashmere Gate, Delhi
For
Schools, colleges, the public and private groups
Length
About 2 hours
When
Any day you choose. Early morning is best in the warmer months.
Led by
A historian or archaeologist who specialises in Delhi's buildings
Language
English, Hindi or both. Other languages on request, through our partners.
Group size
Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.
Meeting point
Agreed with you. A map location is shared once the date is confirmed.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
Price
From ₹9,000 per group, including GST
